usedFor: Copper is where new people land and Contacts+ keeps the address book, so “New Person” can add an entry through “Create a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person” in Copper, then “Create a Contact” in Contacts+
bestTemplate.why: Every new Copper person gets a Contacts+ entry with name, email and phone, so both lists match.

watchOut: “Updated Person” fires on every change in Copper, so “Create a Contact” can run again for someone already added.
